create_form.description: Create a form in a workspace with the questions you list. It starts as a draft, so nobody can answer it until you make it public.
create_form.name: create_form

parameters.description: The workspace. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.description: The form's title, shown at the top of the form.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: Who can open the form. Defaults to draft.
parameters.name: visibility

parameters.description: The form's questions, each with a 'name' and optionally a 'type' (text, email, number, url, phone_number, date, checkbox, rating, select or multi_select), 'required' (true or false), 'help' and, for select and multi_select, 'options' (a list of choices). Leave empty for one short text field called Name.
parameters.name: fields

closes_at.description: When the form stops taking answers

max_submissions_count.description: The most answers it will take

help.description: The help text under the question

hidden.description: True if the field is hidden

name.description: The question shown to the person

required.description: True if it must be answered

type.description: The kind of field, such as text or email

share_url.description: The link people open to fill it in

slug.description: The form's slug, as in its share link

submit_button_text.description: The text on the submit button

workspace_id.description: The id of the workspace it belongs to

create_form_webhook.description: Have OpnForm send every new submission of a form to an https address.
create_form_webhook.name: create_form_webhook

parameters.description: The form. Pick one, or give its slug, id or share link from an earlier step.
parameters.name: form

parameters.description: The https:// address OpnForm sends each submission to.
parameters.name: webhook_url

parameters.description: Whether it starts sending. Defaults to active.
parameters.name: status

data.description: Its settings, such as the webhook address

form_id.description: The id of the form it belongs to

integration_id.description: The kind of integration; webhook for a webhook

delete_form.description: Delete a form together with its submissions.
delete_form.name: delete_form

parameters.description: The form. Pick one, or give its slug, id or share link from an earlier step.
parameters.name: form

deleted.description: Always true once the form is gone

delete_form_webhook.description: Delete a webhook so OpnForm stops sending submissions to it.
delete_form_webhook.name: delete_form_webhook

parameters.description: The form. Pick one, or give its slug, id or share link from an earlier step.
parameters.name: form

parameters.description: The webhook's id, from 'List form integrations' or 'Create webhook'.
parameters.name: integration_id

deleted.description: Always true once the webhook is gone

delete_submission.description: Delete one submission from a form.
delete_submission.name: delete_submission

parameters.description: The form. Pick one, or give its slug, id or share link from an earlier step.

parameters.description: The submission's number, from 'List submissions'. It is not the code 'Submit form' returns.
parameters.name: submission_id

deleted.description: Always true once the submission is gone

submit_form.description: Send an answer to a form, as if someone filled it in. The form must be public, and the answers must satisfy its required fields.
submit_form.name: submit_form

parameters.description: The form. Pick one, or give its slug, id or share link from an earlier step.
parameters.name: form

parameters.description: Each field's name with the answer, for example {"Name": "Ada", "Email": "ada@example.com"}. The field ids are looked up for you.
parameters.name: answers

parameters.description: Turn on to save the answers as an unfinished submission, which skips the required-field check.
parameters.name: is_partial

is_first_submission.description: True if this was the form's first submission

submission_id.description: OpnForm's code for the submission. Use 'List submissions' to get the number other steps take.
